description: SLA support geometry and bounded clustering producer probes

mutants.description: Change the diameter-to-radius conversion to diameter-as-radius; the public half-height pedestal spans then exceed the independently derived frustum widths at the default and upper endpoint.
mutants.expected_oracle: Ordinary cross-section width or support-mesh z-bound assertions fail for the changed setting.

mutants.description: Replace the configured base height with its default; the zero-height and 2 mm public sections no longer match their frustum spans.
mutants.expected_oracle: Ordinary cross-section width or support-mesh z-bound assertions fail for the changed setting.

mutants.description: Replace configured support-head penetration with zero; the public pinhead mesh no longer advances by the requested 0.2 and 0.8 mm relative to its zero endpoint.
mutants.expected_oracle: Ordinary cross-section width or support-mesh z-bound assertions fail for the changed setting.

mutants.description: Disable the empty-cluster singleton fallback; the bounded reject-all predicate case exceeds its call budget and fails an ordinary assertion.
mutants.expected_oracle: The bounded reject-all path sets its exception flag, then REQUIRE_FALSE(budget_exceeded) fails normally.

mutants.description: Force the singleton fallback even after successful clustering; the positive two-point all-accept control must detect a duplicated seed.
mutants.expected_oracle: The positive two-point result contains a duplicate member, failing the ordinary cluster-size assertion.
